message.content:
Midweight wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#3e4247), tailored with a slightly dropped shoulder and structured lapel for an authoritative yet comfortable silhouette.

Slim-fit straight-leg trousers in stone-washed black denim (#0f0f10), featuring a subtle back pocket detail that elongates the leg line while providing comfort around the hips.

Round-toe leather loafers in warm brown suede (#8c7356), chosen to draw attention toward the face and legs rather than the lower torso, grounding the outfit in autumnal warmth.

This look adheres strictly to her "everyday" and "neat" formality preferences while respecting her goal to keep the belly area quiet; the structured blazer provides a clean upper frame without clinging, and the dark, matte denim creates a vertical line that balances her proportions effortlessly. The warm brown suede shoes introduce a soft accent color that complements her skin tone (#5a3a2a) without competing for attention, ensuring the focus remains on her overall posture rather than specific body measurements. Since it is an autumn office day with daylight, the midweight wool and stone-wash fabrics offer both professional polish and seasonal comfort, meeting the dress code perfectly while honoring her wish to avoid highlighting her midsection.
